spans: In order for the Reorganization to occur, all requisite shareholder approvals must be obtained at the Meetings

certain other consents, confirmations and/or waivers from various third parties, including the liquidity provider with respect to the outstanding Series 3 VRDP Shares of the Acquiring Fund, must also be obtained

notes: Initial Form N-14 8C (as filed January 21, 2022) for the reorganization of Nuveen Enhanced Municipal Value Fund (NEV, Target Fund) into Nuveen Municipal Credit Income Fund (NZF, Acquiring Fund); both are leveraged closed-end municipal funds. Dates are bracketed placeholders in this draft: the meeting date ('[●], 2022'), the record date ('[●], 2022') and the expected effective date ('on or about [●], 2022, or such other date as the parties may agree'), so meeting_date, record_date and expected_close are null; only the year 2022 is stated. n_targets is 1 because the filing names a single Target Fund throughout; it is not stated as a number. The vote: Target Fund common shareholders (majority of outstanding common) and Acquiring Fund preferred shareholders only (majority of preferred, as a single class); Acquiring Fund common shareholders do not vote. No new preferred shares are issued. Reorganization costs estimated at $780,000 (Acquiring Fund ~$492,000, Target Fund ~$288,000). The Agreement and Plan of Reorganization (Appendix A) and any outside/termination date fall after the excerpt cut; exchange_ratio, cash_per_share and collar are not stated (NAV-for-NAV exchange with cash only in lieu of fractional shares).
